about: Bible stories tagged as ordered steps in the symbolic grammar (data/connections/grammar/grammar.json). Each step: act, who (roles or figures), where (zone), sense (+ blessed, - cursed), ref, names (the actual people or things), note. 'odd' marks a detail worth asking about (METHOD rule 10). Status 'draft' means an AI drafted it and no person has reviewed it.
